checks.why: a statement id is resolved inside its mapper's namespace: OrderMapper.findById is bound by OrderMapper.xml's <select id="findById">, and UserMapper.xml's statement of the same id belongs to another mapper (#1381)
near miss, the other way round: UserMapper.findById gets its own namespace's statement and not OrderMapper's
a class that only delegates to a mapper declares no statement: its method of the same name gets no mapper XML row, while a non-MyBatis text file naming it is still listed
control: a text file that is not a mapper is still a binding of every method of that name
control: a bare name answers for every declaration of it, so each mapper's statement is listed once, for its own method
a method a mapper inherits from a generic base is bound by the statement in the inheriting mapper's namespace, and only there
